question: What is the approximate molecular weight of common salt?
solution:
The correct answer is __**58 **____**g/mol**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Molecular mass is the total weight of all the atoms or components that make up a molecule.
 
• Sodium and chlorine have molar weights that are respectively
 
• Na =22.989770 g/mol Cl =35.453 g/mol 
 
• Therefore,
 
• the molar mass of sodium chloride is
 
• **22.989770 g/mol +35.453 g/mol = 58.44277 g/mol**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **An ionic molecule called sodium chloride** has sodium and chloride ions in a 1:1 ratio.
 
• Common names for it include table salt, common salt, and halite (the mineral form of common salt).
 
• It is a white, crystalline substance.
 
• It is known as a saline solution when it is in an aqueous state.
